info.title: OneXtel WhatsApp API
info.description:
Create and fetch WhatsApp templates, send template and session messages, upload media and manage opt-in / opt-out lists.

Generated from the OneXtel API reference by scripts/build-openapi.py.

parameters.name: apikey
parameters.description: API key generated for the TUC (telecom user connection) associated with the sending WhatsApp phone number. Example: `7pvxoA4c`.

name.description: Unique template name in the Meta Cloud API. Should be descriptive of the template's purpose (e.g. `zero_tap_authentication_temp_3`).

add_security_recommendation.description: Adds a security note below the OTP message (recommended). Set on the `BODY` component.

code_expiration_minutes.description: OTP code validity in minutes. Set on the `FOOTER` component; required only if the OTP has an expiry.

text.description: Display text for the offer banner.

has_expiration.description: Whether the offer expires. Defaults to `false`.

components.description: Array of component objects — combinations of `HEADER`, `BODY`, `FOOTER`, `BUTTONS`, `LIMITED_TIME_OFFER`, and `CAROUSEL`, depending on template type. See the tabs below.

parameter_format.description: Determines how body/header variables are referenced. `POSITIONAL` (default, e.g. `{{1}}`) or `NAMED` (e.g. `{{customer_name}}`).

message_send_ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live for the message in seconds. Range varies by category: Authentication 30 seconds–15 minutes; Utility 30 seconds–12 hours; Marketing/LTO/Carousel 12 hours–30 days (30-day maximum applies only for MM Lite).

sub_category.description: Only used for `ORDER_STATUS` and `ORDER_DETAILS` utility templates — see those tabs.

data.description: JSON-encoded string containing the template payload (name, category, language, components, etc. — see below). Sent as a form field, not raw JSON.

waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID the template is created under.

cards.description: Array of card objects, each with its own `components` (header + buttons).

post.summary: Send WhatsApp Template Message / Send Session Messages

parameters.name: apikey
parameters.description: API key for the sending WhatsApp number's TUC.

recipient.description: Recipient phone number(s), without country prefix (prefix supplied separately via the root-level `prefix` field).

sender.description: Sender's registered WhatsApp number. A pool ID can also be passed here.

name.description: Name of the approved WhatsApp template.

components.description: Defines all template components to fill in at send time (header, body, button parameters). Shape depends on template type — see the tabs below.

wa.description: Wrapper array for one or more WhatsApp message objects (batch send).

prefix.description: Country prefix applied to all recipients, e.g. `+91`.

flag.description: Set to `1` to enable URL shortening.

urlShortener.description: Optional URL-shortening configuration for links in the message body.

message_send_ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds for the message send. Default `600`.

type.description: Message type — one of `text`, `document` / `image` / `video` / `audio` / `sticker`, `interactive`, or `contacts`. See the tabs below for the value per message type.

contacts.description: Array of contact objects. All fields inside each contact object are optional.

file.description: Media file to upload (image, document, video, etc.), sent as multipart form data.
